source.what: the road matrix of the routing evaluation set: every ordered pair of pool stops
source.engine: Valhalla 3.3.0 (MIT), POST /sources_to_targets, costing "auto" (a van on the road network, no traffic, no temporal effects)
source.data: OpenStreetMap via the Geofabrik NZ extract: https://download.geofabrik.de/australia-oceania/new-zealand-latest.osm.pbf
source.address_source: the LINZ pool (CC BY 4.0, sourced from the LINZ Data Service), fetched by scripts/data/fetch-routing-pool.py
source.query: POST http://127.0.0.1:8002/sources_to_targets, 12 sources per request against all targets, units kilometers; whole metres and whole seconds per ordered pair, NOT symmetrised (one-way streets)
source.fallback_recorded: OSRM was the recorded fallback in docs/research/2026/routing-vrp-engines.md; Valhalla served every pair here, so the fallback was not needed and was not used

rows: i,j,metres,seconds for every ordered pair the engine answered
